eps.d: The residents of Dillydale become involved in physical activities.
The gang heads off to the hospital to tend to their wounds.

While at a nearby farm, Mr. Tickle and Mr. Scatterbrain decide to try their hands at cow milking. Meanwhile, feeding the pigs is harder than it sounds for Mr. Persnickety. Finally, Mr. Nervous visits the chicken pen so that he can collect eggs.

A trip to the movies turns out to be quite the adventure. Meanwhile, Mr. Rude is asked to be the worker for the movie theatre's concession stand. Finally, Little Miss Calamity gets her on screen debut.
The scientific community rejects Mr. Stubborn's beliefs. Meanwhile, Little Miss Whoops takes a field trip to the local planetarium. Finally, Mr. Nervous reluctantly goes on a huge trip in space.

Mr. Quiet uses his free time to visit a lake. Meanwhile, things don't go too smoothly when Mr. Bump tries to water-ski. Finally, Mr. Happy's canoeing trip with Mr. Stubborn doesn't exactly go as planned.
Things go a little bit crazy when Mr. Bump goes to a factory that prints books. Meanwhile, the gang tries to teach Mr. Rude proper manners. Finally, Mr. Persnickety visits a library.
Mr. Scatterbrain opens up a soda shop on the beach. Meanwhile, Mr. Grumpy's sandwhich is almost stepped on. Finally, a parasailing adventure is awkward for Mr. Bump.
We set sail and spend some time at sea.
The Mr. Men and Little Misses spend a day at the mall.

It's a skydiving spectacle when Mr. Bump decides to try it out. Meanwhile, Little Miss Calamity wants to go on a hot air balloon ride. Finally, Mr. Stubborn is forced to fly a plane with passengers on board.
Little Miss Daredevil tries out her newest tightrope act. Meanwhile, Mr. Scatterbrain's favorite hobby is flying kits. Finally, Little Miss Whoops becomes a snake charmer.
Mr. Quiet and Mr. Strong perform a ballet. Meanwhile, tappers interrupt Mr. Grumpy. Finally, Mr. Scatterbrain square dances.
Mr. Grumpy creates a tickle protector jacket. Meanwhile, Mr. Lazy's finds his dream remote control. Finally, Mr. Rude gets lessons in etiquette.
The gang participates in the fair's 'Whack a Clown' competition. Meanwhile, Little Miss Daredevil's aspirations of being shot out of a cannon are realized. Finally, a fun house upsets Mr. Grumpy.

Mr. Stubborn is asked to set up a tent, and hilarity ensues. Meanwhile, Little Miss Chatterbox comes in between the search for a lost dog. Finally, Mr. Grumpy's new camping equipment is littered with bugs.
The gang goes to an amusement park, where the rides aren't always amusing.
The Mr. Men explore trains, both runaway and express, and their tiny cabins.

Little Miss Chatterbox has to stand still and stop talking so that Mr. Rude can paint a portrait of her. Meanwhile, Little Miss Whoops makes traffic a whole lot more hectic. Finally, Mr. Lazy buys a new paint shop and Little Miss Calamity comes to visit.

A scuba diving expedition causes Mr. Nervous to be... nervous. Meanwhile, Mr. Stubborn learns how to ice-fish with the help of Mr. Nosy and Mr. Small. Finally, Mr. Bump causes problems for Mr. Grumpy when they got fishing.
Mr. Bump makes a big leap of faith when he tries his hand at bungee jumping. Meanwhile, Mr. Nervous is under attack from angry animals. Finally, Little Miss Helpful becomes a safari tour guide.
Trouble mounts when Little Miss Whoops heads to a construction yard to use wrecking skills. Meanwhile, Mr. Nervous reluctantly builds a skyscraper. Finally, a barn is built with the help of Mr. Bump.
Mr. Bump has problems building a snowman. Meanwhile, Little Miss Calamity cautiously travels outside during a harsh snowstorm. Finally, the cold means nothing to Mr. Stubborn.
Mr. Rude unleashed his uncanny ability; Little Miss Naughty concocts a sweet corn scam; Little Miss Whoops and Mr. Bump process beans.
Mr. Stubborn applies for a job. Meanwhile, there's a new garbage man in town and his name is Mr. Persnickety. Finally, Little Miss Whoops and Mr. Bump decide to earn a living by moving pianos.
Mr. Nervous unwillingly finds a new type of plant life. Meanwhile, Mr. Scatterbrain and Little Miss Whoops decide to make Mr. Grumpy a garden. Finally, Mr. Quiet spends time in a zen garden.
Mr. Scatterbrain's collection liven up the set of Good Morning Dillydale; Little Miss Calamity wins a precarious prize; and Mr. Nervous survives the perils of playtime!
Mr.Per(s)nickety's refrigerator gives him the cold shoulder; Mr. Happy and Mr. Grumpy share lawn-mowing techniques; and Mr. Bump gets down and dirty cleaning.
Nobody wants to go to Mr. Messy's new pizza shop. Meanwhile, Mr. Rude insults a very nice restaurant. Finally, Mr. Grumpy isn't happy with his new waiter, Mr. Scatterbrain.
Music touches Mr. Strong in a powerful way. Meanwhile, Mr. Noisy makes even more noise with his new drum set. Finally, Mr. Bump and Little Miss Whoops decide to form a band.

Mr. Bump has trouble finding a midnight owl. Meanwhile, Mr. Rude and Mr. Stubborn go on an adventure in the woods. Finally, Little Miss Calamity needs to catch a ghost and she recruits Mr. Nosy and Mr. Small to help her.
Once again, Mr. Stubborn refuses to accept that werewolves exist. Meanwhile, nobody can seem to find Mr. Scatterbrain. Finally, Mr. Lazy's slow appearance causes others to think that he's a mummy.
Little Miss Whoops and Mr. Bump's new food service job is quite difficult. Meanwhile, Mr. Grumpy gets a job at a food court. Finally, Mr. Lazy does a surprisingly good job at work.
Mr. Bump parades around as a singing spider in the school play. Meanwhile, Little Miss Naughty becomes an exterminator. Finally, Mr. Stubborn doesn't believe there are any insects in the apartment.
The gang works in the kitchen.
Rain in Dillydale leads to a leaky roof, a drenching and a ruined picnic.
Little Miss Calamity's ceiling fan is broken. Meanwhile, Mr. Persnickety goes to the beach. Finally, Mr. Rude's air conditioner brings in unwanted guests.
Mr. Nosy and Mr. Small open a mattress warehouse. Meanwhile, Mr. Rude talks in his sleep. Finally, Miss Scary snores.
The gang takes care of yard work outside.
Everyone watches the local parade.
